家計調査報告 1934–35

Kakei chōsa hōkoku (Report of the Household Budget Survey), 自昭和九年九月至昭和十年八月 (September 1934 – August 1935)
內閣統計局 (Cabinet Bureau of Statistics), 東京; issued by 東京統計協會, printed 25 March 1936 (昭和11年3月25日印刷)

Every table is transcribed: the table of households allotted in the survey outline, the in-text tables of the summary of results, the statistical tables 第一表–第七表 (第五表–第七表 for the whole country and each of the ten cities), the tables in the survey regulations, and the classification of income and expenditure; the prose, the charts and the account-book forms are not. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from tight crops (Arabic figures). The national tables 第三表, 第四表 and 第六表 run over several spreads, each spread carrying half the columns or a block of rows: the pieces are joined into one table per printed table, with amounts (實數) and percentages (比例) as separate parts, and a check that no cell was lost or doubled. Decimal points printed as spaces, commas or middle dots are written as normal figures and noted. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted; other doubtful digits are marked [?] even where a total would suggest a reading, and printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Worn and broken digits (9, 0 and 3 alike) are frequent in the city tables of this copy. No errata slip was found. 95 of about 67,000 figures could not be read and are marked [?].
